Remnian Lineage Map

Settled 11 October 2026 from your answers in the Suggestions Workbook, the four follow-up answers, and a check against the 3SL outline. It's a working map, not a manuscript source: where it contradicts a drafted line, the line is listed at the end for revision.

The fixed anchor. Lucia dies on 7 September 2094: about three weeks before 3SL opens, and two years before FTE opens on 9 September 2096.

I

The imperial house

Eden to Lucia's children, with House Lockwood and the Nicholas house of Meridion. Katherine's box is dashed: at FTE she isn't acknowledged.

II

London Town, and House Blackwood

Kinross becomes Augustine through David. House Blackwood stands apart: its Celeste is not Tobias's aunt.

The record, person by person

The imperial house: Mignonette, then Hastings, then Lockwood

The throne takes its consort's name: Mignonette becomes Hastings through Stephen, and Hastings becomes Lockwood through Tobias. Hair and eyes now sort cleanly: crimson hair and gold eyes come from the Hastings side, and emerald eyes come from the Lockwoods.

Checked against the 3SL outline

  • Fits
    The opening The outline starts with Melena already in Shadowmere, carrying Lucia's letter unopened until ch. 5. BSS has her finding it on 18 Sept, so 3SL opening around 28 Sept 2094 holds.
  • Fits
    The letter to Elias Lucia's last words go to her heir. Elias is Crown Prince from her death.
  • Fits
    “Melena Lockwood” The Synod's name for her (ch. 23) matches the Lockwood surname.
  • Fits
    Selah's “Lucia?” Melena has Lucia's crimson hair, so Selah sees Lucia in her (ch. 22). The emerald eyes are Tobias's: that's the green that stops Silas.
  • Fits
    Blackwood “Blackwood's collecting” (ch. 9) is Tiran's house. Renaming Tobias's father to Sawyer keeps “Blackwood” and “Lockwood” from blurring when both are said together (ch. 23).
  • Fits
    Remy's death Ch. 37 falls in autumn 2094, about two years before FTE, as TCD-013 has it.
  • Note
    Tobias is alive He lives until about March 2095, so he's alive (having signed his children away) all through 3SL. Whether Melena thinks of him when she says “I don't know who I am without my mother!” (ch. 20) is your call.
  • Note
    The Epilogue It runs “straight into FTE”, so I'd set it in late August 2096: two years after the main story and days before FTE opens. The outline leaves this to you.
  • Ask
    Asha Noelle Wraithmoor Asha shares Lucia's middle name, and Lucia sat in Selah's kitchen around 2074–2076. If Asha was born around then, she could be named for Lucia. Is that echo intended?
  • Ask
    “Mira” None of Melena's four names contains it. If it should come from a middle name, that would be a fifth name. I'd keep it as Remy's name for her.

Still open

  • Katherine's eyes: emerald would make her Tobias's daughter at a glance.
  • The Epilogue's date: I suggest late August 2096.
  • Whether Asha Noelle is named for Lucia.
  • Where “Mira” comes from (3SL ch. 14): I'd keep it as Remy's name for her, not one of hers.
  • How public Katherine's birth stays (TCD-059): my suggestion is news for a week, unspeakable after, forgotten in twenty years.
